The first release of Encore, a desktop app for YouTube Music.

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Encore_0.1.0_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 and 11 | `Encore_0.1.0_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi`) |
| Debian, Ubuntu | `Encore_0.1.0_amd64.deb` |
| Other Linux | `Encore_0.1.0_amd64.AppImage` |

Playback needs **Python 3.10+** and **Node.js, Deno or Bun** installed. See
[Install](https://github.com/Nayhap/encore#install) for one-line commands.

## First launch

These builds are not code-signed yet.

- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to **System Settings → Privacy &
  Security** and choose **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen warns on first run. Choose **More info**, then
  **Run anyway**. If Smart App Control is on, Windows blocks the app.

## What's in it

- Synced lyrics from YouTube Music and LRCLIB, with a seek bar drawn from them
- Lyrics and the queue side by side, full-screen lyrics, and a ⌘K / Ctrl+K
  search and command box
- Your library, liked songs and playlists, with brand channels
- Native playback with a disk cache, plus shuffle, repeat and autoplay
- Media keys and the system's media controls on all three platforms
- Sign in inside the app, or import your session from a browser

Encore is unofficial and not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
